Verdict written to `iter-03/verdict.json`.

**Overall: 80** (desktop 80, tablet 84, mobile 84)

What I verified by pixel-measuring the PNGs against `geometry.json`:

- **Geometry is exact.** Cards at x=48-479 (432px), y=332-477 / 490-635 / 648-793 (146px tall, 12px gap). Photo frame at x=618-1391 (774px), y=332-851 (520px). 138px empty column-5 trough, 96px bottom padding, 1440x948 render. Trades rows land on y=116/144/172/200 with the right column at x=977 vs Figma's 976.
- **Tokens check out:** h2 48px/48px, -1.92px tracking, weight 450, `rgb(41,29,29)` = ink; eyebrow Overpass Mono Bold 12px/12px +0.12px at 60%; card 24px padding, 28px internal gap, `#ECECEC` hairline.
- **Restraint holds:** the `FPO // Image Placeholder` badge is correctly not shipped, the "Our Team" chip correctly has no scrim, no invented grid lines.

The one substantive gap, unchanged for three iterations: **the team photo (182:2560) is still a flat grey placeholder gradient** (sampled #F6F6F7 → #E5E4E6) filling a 774x520 block, roughly a third of the section. Prior fix logs record this as a run-wide Figma asset quota block, not a section bug, but as a reviewer I score what renders.

Tablet/mobile have no mock, so I judged them on adaptation quality only: no overflow (content bounds 32-735 at 768, to 365 at 390), correct gutters and row gaps, reading order preserved when the trades list drops to one column, photo aspect held. The only spec-backed nit is the heading clamp undershooting the 1024-1279 band by ~5px, which lives in the global `text-display-md` token - a shared-file change I left alone per the brief; a section-local clamp would close it without touching shared files.
